title: Raw GPS pseudoranges of 34 IGS stations on 2025-04-10 (BKG open archive): positions solved from the origin, satellites tracked

radius_enters_via.how: satellite orbits broadcast in the WGS84 frame, whose scale was fixed by stations on the ellipsoid; lat/lon/h on the WGS84 ellipsoid

verdict_rule: Station positions that only solve with kilometre residuals, or that fit a plane better than a sphere; pairs of stations that share satellites well beyond the geometric separation limit.
license_note: IGS data, BKG open archive (https://igs.bkg.bund.de): free, cite the IGS (Johnston et al. 2017). RNXCMP (crx2rnx): GSI terms, cite Hatanaka (2008).

sources.cite: IGS / BKG GNSS data centre, daily RINEX 3 observation files (30 s) and broadcast ephemeris BRDC00IGS, 2025 day 100
Hatanaka, Y. (2008), A Compression Format and Tools for GNSS Observation Data, Bulletin of the Geospatial Information Authority of Japan, 55, 21-30 (RNXCMP)

units.seen: 5-minute bin index from 00:00 GPS time -> GPS PRNs

inputs.origin: Our fixed list of 80 IGS stations, picked from the BKG archive's index.
IGS broadcast ephemeris BRDC00IGS, 2025 day 100, BKG open archive.
IGS daily RINEX 3 observation files (30 s), 2025 day 100, BKG open archive (fog fetch gps-raw).

notes: stations.txt fixes the 34 stations: the script picked them from the archive's index page, read live at every run, and the archive has listed more since (DGAR, POL2, DARW by 2026-10-14). The observation files are decompressed by RNXCMP's crx2rnx (tools/third_party/rnxcmp, make crx2rnx).
